header: Three-year costs for a practice of five
subheader: Talbrunn compared with a paper diary and an external billing service.
lead: The figures come from one customer practice, so you can compare them with your own. Where a number favours us, we say what it leaves out.
note: Basis: five practitioners, one address, about 1,100 treatments a month, prices from July 2026. Excludes hardware, which the practice needs either way, and changes in fund rates.

figures.title: Talbrunn licence, 3 years
figures.text: €89 net a month for 36 months, at the standard price without discounts.

figures.title: Billing service, 3 years
figures.text: €300 a month: the median of four billing services our customers left between 2024 and 2026.

figures.title: Migration
figures.text: Charged in the first month. Staying on paper has no migration cost.

figures.title: Reception time saved
figures.text: Median across 34 changeovers: appointment calls, recall lists and invoices that no longer need manual work.

figures.title: Unplanned downtime, 3 years
figures.text: Both under 40 minutes and during working hours. We published both on our status page the same day.

figures.title: Recovered from missed recalls
figures.text: The lowest figure from three practices that measured it. The other two reported more.
